product_overview: DocMitra provides a lightweight workstation for loading student admission documents, suggesting normalized rename targets, and previewing batch rename changes before execution. It helps users organize files quickly with live shortcut suggestions and a cross-check modal for final review.
core_goals: Load student documents into a unified queue for renaming
Use shortcut codes to generate and refine suggested document filenames
Review old and suggested filenames before confirming a batch rename

features.name: Bulk Document Renaming & Intake Queue
features.description: Allows users to load student documents into a queue, inspect filenames, and move through files while preparing rename targets.
user_flows: Navigate to /index.html -> Load a folder of student documents -> View the files in a unified queue list -> Inspect original filenames and suggested rename targets -> Move between files using click or keyboard navigation

features.name: Reactive Keystroke Smart Suggestions
features.description: Provides live document-type suggestions as the user types a shortcut code and lets them apply a suggestion while adjusting filename casing.
user_flows: Navigate to /index.html -> Type a document shortcut into the Rename To input -> View the Smart Suggestions panel update in real time -> Select a suggestion to apply it to the current file -> Switch between UPPER, Title, and lower casing styles -> See the suggested filename update accordingly

Navigate to /index.html -> Type an unsupported or partial shortcut into the Rename To input -> View the Smart Suggestions panel narrow to relevant matches or empty results -> Refine the typed shortcut until a matching suggestion appears

features.name: High-Speed Cross-Check Preview Modal & Batch Execution
features.description: Lets users open a comparison modal, review old and new filenames side by side, adjust selection, and confirm a batch rename.
user_flows: Navigate to /index.html -> Open the cross-check matched documents modal -> Review old filenames beside suggested new filenames -> Select all or deselect specific documents -> Confirm the batch rename operation

Navigate to /index.html -> Open the cross-check matched documents modal -> Change the casing style between UPPER, Title, and lower -> See the suggested filenames refresh live in the modal -> Keep reviewing the updated filenames without modifying files yet

features.name: Bulk Document Renaming & Intake Queue
features.description: Load intake folders and admission documents, normalize student names, and auto-generate clean destination filenames
user_interactions: Click Select Folder or Add Files button
View loaded files in unified queue list
Inspect original filename and suggested rename target
Navigate between files via click or arrow keys

features.name: Reactive Keystroke Smart Suggestions
features.description: Live narrow admission document shortcuts and types on every keystroke in Rename To input field
user_interactions: Type shortcut code (e.g. 10M, CST, ADR) into Rename To input
See filtered top 5 suggestions update in real time in Smart Suggestions panel
Click suggestion chip to apply document type to current file
Change casing style between UPPER, Title, and lower

features.name: High-Speed Cross-Check Preview Modal & Batch Execution
features.description: 2-column comparison modal verifying old and suggested filenames before executing atomic batch renames
user_interactions: Click Rename Matched button in footer toolbar
Review old name versus suggested new name side by side
Select all or deselect specific documents
Click Confirm and Rename to execute batch operation
